request.reason: The exact PR 1003 hosted quality run failed docs_acceptance because the ordinary read set is 109 bytes over budget and failed conformance_cross_wi_coordination_processes because the guide does not state the required serial-by-default rule. Independent review also reproduced work-item inspect failing on the active Contract's optional concurrencyBoundary:null. Per the user's explicit authorization to continue all corrections through PR merge and cleanup, amend the active plan to include these narrowly related fixes while preserving the original failure evidence.

changes.value: The default ordinary Work Item guide states that one Work Item is serial by default, preserves admitted read-only verification and independent CI fan-out, and remains within the 13,248-byte default read-set budget.
A Work Item Contract with an optional concurrencyBoundary set to null is treated as having no declared boundary; work-item inspect succeeds after Contract amendment, covered by a real CLI regression.

acceptanceCriteria: Sensitive amendment review remains a hard verification admission gate even when stale-preflight recovery is available; before valid human review, status and per-action admission reject run_verification and the regression proves no verification process is started.
After a valid review receipt, verification may be admitted only after fresh Runtime projection; existing recovery and stale-preflight behavior remains covered.

The ordinary Work Item guide and workflow-convergence gate agree on serial lifecycle, safe verification parallelism, independent CI fan-out, and fresh receipt reuse; the exact CI regression passes.
Candidate Runtime 1.0.0 canonical verification passes for the final source snapshot, and the exact PR head has passing hosted checks and an independent review with no unresolved blocker before merge.
